definition.en: UNIDO is the specialized agency of the United Nations that promotes industrial development for poverty reduction, inclusive globalization, and environmental sustainability.
definition.hi: UNIDO is the specialized agency of the United Nations that promotes industrial development for poverty reduction, inclusive globalization, and environmental sustainability.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, UNIDO is relevant in the context of industrial policy, sustainable development goals, and international cooperation. Understanding its role helps in analyzing India's industrial growth strategies and alignment with global standards.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC GS-3, UNIDO is relevant in the context of industrial policy, sustainable development goals, and international cooperation. Understanding its role helps in analyzing India's industrial growth strategies and alignment with global standards.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the mandate and functions of UNIDO in the global economy.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the mandate and functions of UNIDO in the global economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the intersection of industrial development and sustainable economic growth.
